no-restricted-syntax.message: `any` is forbidden (code-standards §3). Use `unknown` and validate it against a schema.
Casting to `any` defeats the type checker. Narrow the type instead.

patterns.message: R5: import the feature's public entry point (@/features/<name>), not its internals. See docs/architecture.md §5. Genuinely shared code belongs in @/shared; generic HTTP plumbing belongs in @/lib.
